verdict.rationale: Greptile ships an official CLI (greptile review, greptile onboard) that runs headlessly and is scriptable in CI/automation, confirmed by docs and a runtime probe showing keyless npm install/version check, plus an MCP server for agentic access and self-hosted deployment options for CI-integrated pipelines. missing for 10: no explicit CI-pipeline (e.g. GitHub Actions) config example or independent hands-on report of running greptile review inside a CI job.
